upstream.description: Hivemind turns your traces into reusable skills across agents

classification.analysis: Hivemind is a cloud-backed shared-memory service (from Activeloop/Deeplake) that captures every coding-agent session's prompts, tool calls, and responses as structured traces, then mines them into reusable SKILL.md files that propagate across every agent on a team. It installs via a single npm command and wires hooks/MCP/plugins into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, pi, and Claude Cowork, with hybrid lexical+semantic search over traces and skills, BYOC storage (GCS/Azure/S3/on-prem), and session summarization into wiki pages. Aimed at teams who want a single 'brain' so one engineer's fix becomes every agent's capability, with published LoCoMo benchmark numbers showing cost/token/turn reductions versus no shared memory.

use_cases.title: Share one memory brain across a team's coding agents
Auto-generate reusable SKILL.md files from agent traces
Search past agent sessions with hybrid lexical and semantic retrieval
Bring your own cloud storage for captured agent session data
